title: ValiDate
tagline: ValiDate: A decentralized dating app where users connect authentically through blind interactions, fostering genuine connections while ensuring privacy with zeroknowledge-verified age and gender.
description: Presenting ValiDate, a groundbreaking decentralized dating app that reshapes the art of forging connections and cultivating relationships. With ValiDate, users embark on a voyage of blind interactions, diving into profound conversations prior to forming judgments. Empowered by state-of-the-art zeroknowledge validation, users confidently rely on the credibility of age and gender details, establishing an environment of authenticity and security. Upon login, a myriad of profiles, each disclosing only age and gender, becomes accessible, intensifying curiosity as users opt for 5-minute introductory chats, seizing initial impressions. A pivotal choice arises thereafter: persist or move forward. Choosing to proceed unveils a 48-hour dialogue window, enabling a comprehensive bond reminiscent of speed dating. To sustain this captivating journey, users can acquire an NFT subscription, extending conversations and exploring matches beyond the initial phase. ValiDate is a catalyst for a dating revolution, nurturing genuine bonds while safeguarding excitement and privacy. The landing page features an illustration with a central pomegranate—a symbol representing diverse and non-uniform relationships, thoughtfully replacing the traditional emphasis on the apple in love stories. This mystical addition, akin to tarot cards, injects a captivating sense of intrigue and excitement.
how_its_made: Once you open the application you have to connect your wallet to proceed further to verify yourself. ValiDate operates across three chains Optimism, Mode, and Base leveraging the secure Safe wallet integration. Once connected to your chosen chain, you verify your identity through the worldcoin application. After successful verification, upload age and gender documents to proceed to profile browsing. Engage in 5-minute interactions to decide further connections. Following the initial encounter, a pivotal choice emerges. For continuous access beyond 48 hours, secure a subscription via purchasing an NFT, minted on Zora. ValiDate harmonizes advanced blockchain technologies, seamless identity validation, and captivating matchmaking, redefining modern dating.
